# CONFORMANCE FIXTURE -- the registry is EDITED AFTER the artifact was generated.
# `<name>.after.txt` is written over docs/error-codes.txt once `error-codes generate` has
# run, so the committed artifact no longer describes the registry on disk.
# The gate ACCEPTED the original, but the tool must still REFUSE: it may only answer for
# the bytes that are there NOW, and those bytes have never been checked by anything.
# This is the case NO amount of parser agreement would have caught.

E3010 SemanticUnneededCast
	csharp SemanticUnneededCast
	shv2 unneededCast
	doc A cast is redundant: the value already has the destination type.

E5001 CodeEmitterRegisterPressure
	shv2 registerPressure
	doc Out of registers, and no spill placement is forced.
